name: EPIC 212414249
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 12.8 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212414249 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.782303 (16th-84th percentiles 12.163454-13.49111), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212414249: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4647.1196 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212414249 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3298.359375 (16th-84th percentiles 3166.171875-3438.632812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,298 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.96 solar masses and 12.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,647 K at its surface.
